answer_1.quote: We evaluate IMPLEXCONV and TACITREE via question-answering tasks ... The final construction phase generates realistic multi-turn conversations ...
answer_1.outputs: Generated QA answers and multi-turn dialogue responses

answer_2.quote: We use the F1 score, which balances both relevance (recall) and conciseness (precision). ... We analyze the trade-off between performance and token usage by measuring the token-to-accuracy ratio.

answer_3.quote: We prompt an LLM to judge whether the predicted answer is semantically equivalent to the ground truth.

answer_4.quote: We also conduct human evaluation to verify correctness. For human evaluation, we randomly sample 100 examples from each dataset and instruct human annotators to assess the validity of the model-generated responses.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators assess the validity of the model-generated responses following the guidelines detailed in Code 10.
